doc.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

title: Ray Bauduc joins the interview and gives his background
summary: Ray sits down, the interviewer sets up the joint interview, and Ray gives his name and says he was born and raised in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Yeah. Better sit down here, Ray. Well, that's all right, Ray. Just sit down. Sit down. No, no, no, there's plenty of chairs here. I'll just get to do something over here. All right. If you all, maybe we could talk together, and if you wanted one of you to be upstairs, get a little bit of a bed in.
Well, we're glad to do this, man. Yeah.
Yeah, we just said your brother taught him. I was going to ask you, you might give your name, Ray, so we'll have your voice down here recognized.
All right, my name is Ray Bauduc.
Uh-huh. Can you tell when you were born?
Well, I was born and raised down in New Orleans.
You'll have to lean over. I don't pick up anything around here, I think. Huh? What is the birth date?
Well, the birth date? Well, we'll just say just about the same time Jack Benny's tope was born.
